executiveAssessment.text: JW Marriott Hotel Monterrey Valle currently shows AI Consideration of 45.2% and Scenario Presence of 92.1%, with Reality Coverage at 46.7%. Strongest governed signal: Often placed near the top when AI ranks hotels. Primary constraint: Not appearing consistently in AI answers. Versus the prior published run (2026-09-08), material headline movement is AI Consideration +45.2 pp and Scenario Presence +92.1 pp. Independent Positioning shows #1 of 9 with Portfolio AI Presence 45.2%. Overall Core performance is mixed: some indicators are competitive while others still show material gaps. Management should protect the stronger signals while closing the specific gaps that are already visible in evidence.

positiveSignal.title: Positive Signal
positiveSignal.body: Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, JW Marriott Hotel Monterrey Valle appeared in the Top 3 93.1% of the time. This shows how prominently the hotel is positioned when AI includes it.

secondaryCallout.title: Performance Risk
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 92.1% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 45.2% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.

managementPriority.title: Management Priority
managementPriority.body: Prioritize correcting high-severity reality gaps and the information conditions behind displacement by AC Hotel by Marriott Monterrey Valle.
